description: OKRs built with SvGrid Base for Svelte 5: key results measure progress from start to target with a formula, objectives average them with a rollup. Views by objective, a confidence board, a weekly check-in and a progress chart, with automations for off-track and achieved results.

faq.question: How is progress worked out?
faq.answer: Each key result has a formula, (Current minus Start) divided by (Target minus Start), held between 0 and 100%. Each objective averages its key results with a rollup of that formula.

faq.question: What happens when a target is reached?
faq.answer: An automation marks the key result Achieved, stamps the check-in date and shows a notice. One that falls Off track turns red.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base is part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key it runs with a watermark, so it can be evaluated as is.
